hardDailyBounds.encodedContributorBytesBasis: Exact maximum encoded bytes/day measured by the accepted 12A-40 128-contributor benchmark across the conservative 180-day fixture using 300 category rows/day and 1108 logical contributors/day. The bound is not rounded upward.

selectedCandidateContract.failCloseRule: Precompute the complete day. If any hard daily bound is exceeded, persist only authoritative day status and expose no category or contributor aggregate rows for that day.
selectedCandidateContract.historyReadSemantics: Select provider/category/day chunks first, expand every contributor tuple from every selected chunk, aggregate all selected days by streamer, then rank/cap. Missing or fail-closed days remain unavailable rather than zero.

decisionRationale.why128: 12A-40 measured the smallest safety-adjusted 180-day storage at chunk size 128 while preserving exact results and all contributors.
decisionRationale.why47196BytesPerDay: It is the accepted benchmark's measured maximum for the conservative fixture that includes the real 1108-pair overflow shape. Using the measured maximum unchanged repairs the observed representation failure without consuming unmeasured capacity headroom.
decisionRationale.whyNotHigher: A higher boundary would require a new deterministic local storage benchmark before it could be justified under the existing Free Strong limits.
decisionRationale.whyNotLogicalPairCap: Logical contributor cardinality must remain complete. Truncating logical pairs would violate filter-before-ranking exactness.
